rows.quantity: declared numerator, denominator, net/gross and batch basis
rows.prospective_method: Specify useful recovered energy and liquefaction investment on the same nitrogen inventory, conditioning and system boundary before comparison.
rows.rejection_condition: A bookkeeping fraction treated as observation, unmatched inventories/boundaries or an undefined useful-energy denominator.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: all electrical/thermal inputs and auxiliary energy for the matched inventory
rows.prospective_method: Prospective calibrated input records include preparation, conditioning, liquefaction and auxiliaries; retain source and raw time histories.
rows.rejection_condition: Assumed unit cost used as measured investment, omitted preparation/auxiliary demand or external input excluded from the boundary.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: gross output, internal/auxiliary use and net useful output
rows.prospective_method: Prospective synchronized observations separate recovered shaft/bus energy from internal process/control/pump demand and distribution losses.
rows.rejection_condition: Gross ideal expansion energy credited as net useful output, storage discharge mislabelled recovery or auxiliary loss omitted.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: loaded, processed, retained, vented and lost nitrogen
rows.prospective_method: Specify calibrated inventory/flow observations and tank tare with matched start/end states and accounting for vent/leak/retained material.
rows.rejection_condition: Liquid/gas inventories or tank contents counted twice, loss silently zero or output matched to a different nitrogen batch.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: pressure, temperature, phase and conditioning history
rows.prospective_method: Prospective state observations identify each process boundary and conditioning state alongside input/output records.
rows.rejection_condition: Assumed ideal state credited as observed process performance or unmatched phase/pressure/temperature.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Disclose heat sources and heat rejection
rows.quantity: all heat transfers, ambient state and external heat contribution
rows.prospective_method: Specify calibrated heat-source/rejection records and the declared airborne boundary; retain any environmental or external contribution separately.
rows.rejection_condition: An external heat source omitted while claiming reproduction without one, ideal heat exchange assumed or unmatched thermal start/end states.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Separate ideal bookkeeping from process losses
rows.quantity: thermal, mechanical, electrical and distribution losses
rows.prospective_method: Prospective complete input/output/state records identify loss terms and unresolved balance residuals rather than crediting a lossless identity as system evidence.
rows.rejection_condition: Lossless accounting identity declared observed fraction, losses omitted or unexplained residual assigned useful recovery.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Identify the complete plant mass boundary
rows.quantity: complete installed process equipment bill and allocated mass
rows.prospective_method: Record the actual configured plant, auxiliaries, heat exchangers, controls, plumbing, wiring, supports and shared-component allocations before weighing.
rows.rejection_condition: Selected core machine or catalogue mass substituted for a complete installed plant, omitted auxiliaries or duplicated shared hardware.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Identify the complete tank mass boundary
rows.quantity: tank, insulation, supports, fittings and dry/wet inventory boundary
rows.prospective_method: Prospective configured tank record separates dry vessel/insulation/support hardware from operating fluid inventory and connections.
rows.rejection_condition: Nominal empty vessel mass treated as full installed system, fluid counted as dry mass or insulation/attachments omitted.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Observe plant/tank mass and reconcile the dry ledger
rows.prospective_method: Specify conditioned weighing and complete configuration evidence; link each included/excluded/shared item to the existing dry-ledger definition.
rows.rejection_condition: Calculated/catalogue mass treated as weighed, incomplete bill credited as complete dry mass or plant/tank contribution counted twice.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Observe a complete repeatable duty cycle
rows.quantity: startup, operating, transient, shutdown and turnaround histories
rows.prospective_method: Prospective synchronized process records specify an operating episode and repeat-cycle thermal/inventory/energy conditions, including preparation and turnaround.
rows.rejection_condition: One steady state extrapolated to a sustainable duty cycle, omitted startup/cooldown/turnaround or mismatched initial/final storage/thermal state.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: complete installation, ambient/load context and bus interfaces
rows.units: configuration identifiers; Pa; K; W; kg
rows.prospective_method: Prospective integration record identifies the same complete airborne plant/tank configuration and operating context used for fraction, mass and duty observations.
rows.rejection_condition: Bench-only/core-component or external-heat evidence credited as complete airborne system performance; selected hardware or operating capability inferred here.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.quantity: calibration, time alignment, uncertainty and immutable source identity
rows.prospective_method: Attach calibrated raw observations and uncertainty for every input/output/inventory/mass/state/duty comparison, with an applicable separately adopted acceptance basis.
rows.rejection_condition: Uncalibrated/missing observation promoted to agreement, invented confidence/band or source assumption treated as a measurement.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

rows.requirement: Keep fraction, mass and duty-cycle acceptance distinct
rows.quantity: matched fraction evidence, complete mass and sustained duty records
rows.prospective_method: Require separately applicable observations for fraction, complete plant/tank mass and duty cycle; retain UNKNOWN for missing evidence even if another comparison succeeds.
rows.rejection_condition: A source-assumed fraction establishes a buildable plant, a component result substitutes for complete system evidence or UNKNOWN is promoted to PASS.
rows.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; source assumptions are comparison context, not observed system acceptance

missing_semantics: Null means unavailable physical observation or adopted acceptance criterion; never zero, measured agreement or completed qualification.
scope: No new fraction, production, plant/tank mass or sustainable duty prediction; no selected hardware, process calculation, physical/native action, source modification or remote issue mutation.
